title: Miss Delicious in Dungeon? This New 2027 Anime Could Be For You
content:
An anime with similar vibes to Delicious in Dungeon will premiere next year, and fans would not want to miss it. There’s no denying that Delicious in Dungeon is one of the greatest fantasies of the 2020s. While the manga has already ended, the anime will be returning with a second season in October next year. Fans are already hyped for the anime’s return, especially after the first season reached its conclusion with a major cliffhanger where Laois and his party thought of an unconventional way to save Falin. While fans still have to wait several months before the anime’s return, a new fantasy series has also been announced.

Now that 2026 is closer to its end than ever, the 2027 anime series are all set for their premiere. From the lineup so far, it’s evident that 2027 will turn out to be another exciting year for anime fans, maybe even better than 2026. However, there’s one anime that fans of Delicious in Dungeon need to watch when it premieres. Revealed via a Kadokawa press release, Soara and the House of Monsters gets a new key visual and promotional video. The anime was already announced in July this year, but Kadokawa shared major updates, especially a 2027 release window along with everything else fans need to know for now.

What Is Soara and the House of Monsters About?

The anime is based on an acclaimed manga by Hidenori Yamaji, which is currently being serialized in Shogakukan’s manga app Sunday Webry. The new visual and promotional trailer were revealed on November 18th, 2026, to commemorate Good House Day in Japan. The story centers around Soara, a young orphaned girl raised by knights. She is trained to battle monsters that constantly attack the kingdom, but by the time she is old enough to participate in a real battle, peace has been declared in her kingdom. Now that the skills she spent her whole life learning are of no use, Soara begins to search for a new home and a purpose in life.

Just when all hope seemed lost, she encounters Krik, a dwarf and leader of the Monster Architects. Before long, the girl finds herself working with the Monster Architects to build comfortable homes for them. Produced by Felix Film Studio, the anime is being directed by Takaharu Ozaki, best known for Goblin Slayer. The series composition is done by Ayumu Hisao, while the character design is provided by Tomoko Iwasa. The latest cast members were also revealed in the press release, with Reiji Kawashima as Niko and Kenta Miyake as Gansho. The voices behind Soara (Ikumi Hasegawa) and Krik (Ayumu Murase) were already revealed before this latest update.

How Is Soara and the House of Monsters Similar to Delicious in Dungeon ?

While both stories have different narrative structures , they have similar settings and an overall vibe. Soara and the House of Monsters has rich world-building that examines how monsters live, adapt, and fit into their environment, rather than simply treating them as foes to defeat. While one anime centers around architecture and the other is mostly about cooking, both are skills that require practical problem-solving and remodeling spaces to suit different monsters. This upcoming anime will be perfect for fans who love fantasy themes and character growth with a slower, slice-of-life rhythm rather than focusing on intense battle actions.

Are you excited to see this upcoming anime bring its own blend of fantasy and adventure to anime? Do you think it could capture the same appeal as Delicious in Dungeon ? Share your thoughts in the comments.

title: Even After 9 Years, This is Still Goku’s Best Kamehameha in Dragon Ball Super
content:
Dragon Ball has featured its fair share of iconic moments over the decades, but few can come close to Goku’s most iconic Kamehameha. While Kamehameha is far from new, it’s easily one of the most memorable techniques in all Shonen. Dragon Ball raised entire generations of Shonen fans who grew up watching Goku deliver his most powerful attacks against his opponents. Things changed when the manga received its sequel to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the series’ finale. Written by Akira Toriyama and illustrated by Toyotaro, Dragon Ball Super immediately became a massive hit as it introduced its multiverse and a whole new level of power that no one thought was possible.

In Episodes 109 and 110 that were aired as a one-hour special, Goku unlocked his Ultra Instinct , an ability that only deities are capable of using. Also known as the “State of the Gods,” Ultra Instinct allows a user to sever the link between their consciousness and body, allowing them to dodge all kinds of attacks subconsciously. Following the groundbreaking debut of Ultra Instinct, Goku kept using this form through the rest of the tournament. On November 19th, 2017, Dragon Ball Super released Episode 116 in Japan, where Goku used the most powerful Kamehameha in the entire series.

Dragon Ball Super Episode 116 Features Goku’s Kamehameha in His Ultra Instinct State

Jiren wasn’t the only powerful opponent Goku and the others had to fight in the Tournament of Power. Universe 6 is also full of powerful warriors who were willing to do anything within their power to win the tournament and save their universe. Since it’s parallel to Universe 7, it also has Saiyans with similar powers. During the final stretch of the tournament, Kale and Caulifa fused together and fought against Goku . Usually a fusion like that would ensure their victory, but even they never anticipated that Goku’s Ultra Instinct state is on a league of its own.

Kefla used all her power to ensure Goku stayed down, even to the point of exhausting her last bit of energy to launch powerful energy waves. Thanks to his Ultra Instinct state, Goku swiftly dodged each one of those attacks effortlessly, which otherwise would’ve been impossible. Instead of firing straight ahead, which he usually did , this time Goku rode along Kefla’s giant energy wave to close the distance and get above her. Jumping through the energy waves, he managed to launch a Kamehameha that ensured his victory against Kefla with a point-blank finisher.

What truly makes this attack special is that this is the first time he used Kamehameha in his Ultra Instinct state, and it didn’t fail in depicting the level of power Goku has been able to accomplish. It was already a fan-favorite moment among manga fans, but Toei Animation did justice to this scene with exceptional animation and fluid choreography, making it one of the best moments in Dragon Ball history.

Which Kamehameha moment in Dragon Ball Super is your personal favorite? Do you think any future battle could top Goku’s Kamehameha in Episode 116? Share your picks in the comments below.

title: Major Fantasy Reboot Confirms Season 2 Return After 3 Years With New Look
content:
Rebooted adaptations of classic anime franchises have become increasingly popular in recent years, with seasonal lineups featuring star-studded titles making massive comebacks like Science Saru’s modernized spin on Ghost in the Shell and TMS Entertainment’s reboot of Fruits Basket , both of which promised to deliver stories that were more faithful retellings of their respective source materials. This trend is only set to continue with the long-awaited announcement that Studio Passione’s reboot of Isuna Hakekura’s original series Spice and Wolf will be getting a second season. The series has joined the Winter 2027 Anime Season with a release window set for sometime in January.

The first season of the Spice and Wolf reboot promised a more faithful adaptation of the original light novel from Isuna Hakekura compared to its 2008 predecessor from Imagin. In that, Season 1 adapted volumes 1 through 4 of the original series, including the fourth volume’s Legend of the Pagan God’s arc, which the original anime skipped, as well as tying in a short story featured in the series’ seventh volume. The reboot was met with overwhelming praise from fans, and now the series will finally be making a return to continue the anime’s adaptation of previously skipped story material, including Volume 6 of the original light novel series which has never been animated before.

Spice and Wolf Blends Folk Fantasy With A Dash Of Romance

Spice and Wolf focuses on the travels of Kraft Lawrence , a wandering merchant who, in a chance encounter, meets Holo: a harvest deity with wolf-like traits who joins him in his travels to return to her homeland. Along the way, the pair continue to manage Lawrence’s mercantile business and navigate the politics of the land in their journey. While many fantasy series similar to Spice and Wolf take its heroes on some grand, “save the world” adventure, Holo and Kraft’s story is more of a slow burn tale that puts emphasis on building the world they exist in and the many faces they encounter on their way north.

Spice and Wolf is famous for its slow burn romance between Holo and Kraft as well, showcasing the dichotomy of their lives as a spirt-human pair, and the stark differences in their ambitions. The series is a critical and commercial success as well, in 2020, just four years before the anime’s reboot began releasing, the original light novel series had sold over 5 million copies, with the English localization of the series debuting at No. 4 on The New York Times Bestsellers List for manga. In the 2007 edition of Kono Light Novel ga Sugoi! , Holo ranked first in the “Best Female Category,” a testament to how dedicated readers were to the wolf deity when the series was at its peak.

Spice and Wolf ‘s Original Anime Deviated From Its Source Material In Bizarre Ways

The original anime adaptation from Imagin in 2008, as well as its second season in 2009 from Brain’s Base and Marvy Jack drew out the series already slow burn pacing with multiple anime-original filler arcs while skipping an entire volume’s worth of material. This resulted in the second season of the original Spice and Wolf anime to end on a cliffhanger that took the reboot a single season to reach. Additionally, the original anime adaptation replaced one of the light novel’s characters, a man named Yarei, with an anime-original female character named Chloe. This caused much of Lawrence and Holo’s characterization to shift, as well as some of the thematic implications of their relationship.

In the novels and 2024 adaptation of the anime, Yarei is a young up-and-coming farmer with aspirations to become a merchant from Pasloe who serves as Lawrence’s foil early in the story. While Yarei serves as something of an antagonist in these versions of the story, his replacement in the 2008 anime, Chloe, is also antagonistic — but for a completely different reason. Chloe is introduced as another aspiring merchant from Pasloe with similar ambitions to Yarei, however, Chloe’s character differs greatly in that much of her conflict comes from her unrequited feelings for Lawrence.

While she shared similar struggles to Yarei, such as her dreams to modernize Pasloe and no longer rely on a pagan deity, the sudden injection that she and Holo be romantic rivals felt suffocating among the ongoing religious and economic conflict already present in the story. Considering how hard the the team at Studio Passione have worked to bring the complete, original story of Spice and Wolf to life , the second season releasing in 2027 should remain just as faithful as the first. What do you think of the Spice and Wolf reboot so far? Let us know in the comments.

title: Love Overgeared? Watch These 3 Anime Next
content:
Overgeared has emerged as the biggest webtoon anime adaptation of the Fall 2026 season, gaining recognition as a Solo Leveling replacement as well. However, the anime is more than just a replacement for Solo Leveling with similar elements, as it has its own nuances that set it apart from other webtoons that have received anime adaptations.

It achieves this through a very different protagonist, featuring a laid-back hero who is desperate for power and wealth, something constantly highlighted through his actions. Meanwhile, it also incorporates game and leveling-up systems, elements that have become increasingly popular in the anime industry. This is why there are several anime similar to Overgeared , two of which were released this year, including one that is currently airing.

3) The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life

One of the intriguing elements of Overgeared is undoubtedly its power fantasy, as Grid continues to grow stronger with every new obstacle. However, what sets it apart is its incorporation of comedy through its protagonist and the elements that complement his character. This is exactly why the currently airing anime The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life is a great choice for Overgeared fans to watch alongside it in Fall 2026. The series features a laid-back protagonist, Rein, who gets kicked out of his party because he is no longer needed.

Since Rein was an enhancer and his party members had already maxed out their weapons, he was dismissed. As he leaves, he takes back all the enhancements he had provided to his party members and transfers them into a copper sword. This turns his weapon into an overpowered asset capable of withstanding anything that comes his way. Its laid-back journey, hilarious moments, and Rein’s crafting skills make this anime remarkably similar to Overgeared , allowing it to scratch that same itch better than almost any other series.

2) Tomb Raider King

Another anime that aired this year and is fairly similar to Overgeared is Tomb Raider King . The anime was dubbed a replacement for Solo Leveling in Summer 2026 , and with Overgeared being labeled the replacement for Solo Leveling in Fall, fans are sure to enjoy either series if they liked the other. Tomb Raider King also features a protagonist on a journey of self-development, but it adds the intrigue of time travel to the mix.

Having regressed in time, Seo Jooheon takes his second chance seriously, acquiring everything he needs for his self-development. What makes this refreshing is its older protagonist, making his choices and journey feel more mature and serious rather than comedic. Jooheon’s actions are also quite brutal, allowing him to overshadow even Solo Leveling ‘s Jinwoo in this regard. With a unique leveling-up system that further incorporates the gaming theme, Tomb Raider King is a must-watch for fans of both Solo Leveling and Overgeared .

1) Shangri-La Frontier

With virtual reality gaming serving as its foundation, Overgeared is an MMORPG built around the game Satisfy. This is why Shangri-La Frontier is arguably the anime that comes closest to what Overgeared represents. It features a protagonist who has played numerous trash games before moving on to the popular virtual reality game Shangri-La Frontier and embarking on a quest to dominate it. Going by the in-game name Sunraku and sporting a bird mask, the series makes comedy one of its biggest strengths.

Sunraku is always in tactical mode, finding the best possible ways to acquire loot and rewards. The series delivers pretty much everything expected of a game-based narrative, exploring new areas, fighting new bosses, and gearing up, while other online players also make their presence felt throughout the story. If what Overgeared has offered so far appeals to you, then there is arguably no better anime than Shangri-La Frontier to scratch that same itch.

title: Dragon Ball Super Already Locked In the Next Z Fighter & They Need Their Anime Debut
content:
Almost every Dragon Ball arc adds another warrior to the Z Fighters, and Granolah looks like he could be next. The last remaining Cerealian boasts all the key characteristics that fit into Goku’s band of highly moral misfits. Granolah survived the destruction of his planet thanks to Bardock, but it doesn’t come without collateral damage. The situation creates Granolah’s deep disdain toward the Saiyans, by proxy of Frieza. He doesn’t care where the sole blame lays at the start of his arc, but he eventually understands that the evil emperor is to blame. The manga introduced him some time ago, but he awaits his anime debut .

Granolah also didn’t join up with the Z Fighters after his arc was completed. Goku and Vegeta offered him up the opportunity to come train with them. However, he decides to stay and gather the Dragon Balls. He currently continues his journey and hasn’t made an appearance since in the manga. The way Granolah’s story ends is incomplete, so there’s no way he won’t get an expanded role later .

Understandable Rival Becomes Ally

Similar to Tien, Piccolo and Vegeta, these former foes turned allies realize what a good person Goku is and what he’s trying to accomplish. Vegeta in particular looks to just avenge his planet, similar to Granolah, but goes the wrong way about it initially. His change to the Z Fighters took some more time, but Granolah ran through similar problems. He’s never told about Bardock protecting him . He’s just told the Saiyans caused his race’s destruction.

Granolah works for the Heeters, who use his disdain for the Saiyans, to try and defeat Goku and Vegeta. The plan backfires, as Granolah discovers the truth and flips sides. Even though he’s not a Saiyan or Namekian, Granolah has proven himself to be a competent fighter and representative of his race. Cerealians use an enhanced right eye to find their opponents’ weak points, and he regularly proves he can do so in his battles with Goku and Vegeta.

Granolah Aims, Pun Intended, To Take On Frieza

A way to get Granolah and Frieza’s recent new transformation, Black Frieza , into the anime, is that the two eventually duke it out. With Granolah’s recent power-up wish, there isn’t much time. The Cerealian gave up 150 years of his life to attain all the power levels he would’ve achieved in his life right away. The choice gives him a limited amount of time to find Frieza and defeat him.

Worlds are set to collide with Frieza’s return in the arc and Granolah’s hunt for him. In fact, at the time that the Frieza Force was around for the Cerealian destruction, King Cold and a non-canon Cooler would have been alive. This would be a great opportunity to bring the Frieza family back into the story and give them the proper, revenge-filled defeat at the hands of the last living Cerealian.

Granolah is canon, so it’s not like bringing him into the fold would be that difficult. No retconning required, just an easy addition is all that needs to happen. Granolah would add another great fighter capable of going toe-to-toe with high-powered enemies and also a new ability that can aid the group. His long range attacks and quick-study of rival fighters could certainly come in handy. Should Granolah be brought into Dragon Ball Super ‘s anime future? Let us know in the comments.

However, he decides to stay and gather the Dragon Balls. He currently continues his journey and hasn’t made an appearance since in the manga. The way Granolah’s story ends is incomplete, so there’s no way he won’t get an expanded role later .
Understandable Rival Becomes Ally

Similar to Tien, Piccolo and Vegeta, these former foes turned allies realize what a good person Goku is and what he’s trying to accomplish. Vegeta in particular looks to just avenge his planet, similar to Granolah, but goes the wrong way about it initially. His change to the Z Fighters took some more time, but Granolah ran through similar problems. He’s never told about Bardock protecting him . He’s just told the Saiyans caused his race’s destruction.

Granolah works for the Heeters, who use his disdain for the Saiyans, to try and defeat Goku and Vegeta. The plan backfires, as Granolah discovers the truth and flips sides. Even though he’s not a Saiyan or Namekian, Granolah has proven himself to be a competent fighter and representative of his race. Cerealians use an enhanced right eye to find their opponents’ weak points, and he regularly proves he can do so in his battles with Goku and Vegeta.
Granolah Aims, Pun Intended, To Take On Frieza

A way to get Granolah and Frieza’s recent new transformation, Black Frieza , into the anime, is that the two eventually duke it out. With Granolah’s recent power-up wish, there isn’t much time. The Cerealian gave up 150 years of his life to attain all the power levels he would’ve achieved in his life right away. The choice gives him a limited amount of time to find Frieza and defeat him.

Worlds are set to collide with Frieza’s return in the arc and Granolah’s hunt for him. In fact, at the time that the Frieza Force was around for the Cerealian destruction, King Cold and a non-canon Cooler would have been alive. This would be a great opportunity to bring the Frieza family back into the story and give them the proper, revenge-filled defeat at the hands of the last living Cerealian.

Granolah is canon, so it’s not like bringing him into the fold would be that difficult. No retconning required, just an easy addition is all that needs to happen. Granolah would add another great fighter capable of going toe-to-toe with high-powered enemies and also a new ability that can aid the group. His long range attacks and quick-study of rival fighters could certainly come in handy. Should Granolah be brought into Dragon Ball Super ‘s anime future? Let us know in the comments.

title: Criterion Channel Adds Speed Racer Anime
content:
Shout! Studios released the Speed Racer anime on digital platforms in June 2024. The company released both the English-dubbed version and the original Japanese version Mach GoGoGo on video-on-demand. Shout! Studios also released the entire series on Blu-ray Disc on August 25. Funimation previously released the anime on Blu-ray Disc/DVD.

The 1967-68 car-racing anime Mach GoGoGo was licensed by Trans-Lux and released in the United States in 1967 as Speed Racer . The worldwide rights for the Speed Racer property reverted to Tatsunoko Production from American licensing company Speed Racer Enterprises (SRE) in 2011, though Tatsunoko filed lawsuits against SRE to uphold the reversion, and they were not dismissed until 2014.

title: Grotesqqque Anime Film Screens in Los Angeles on December 3 for 1-Week Only
content:
Aniplex of America announced on Thursday that it will screen Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) at Alamo Drafthouse Cinema Downtown Los Angeles for one week only starting on December 3. Tickets are on sale on the theater's website . Aniplex of America streamed an English-subtitled trailer:

The screenings will include a free randomly distributed illustration card while supplies last. The cards feature exclusive art by the three stories' character designers.

• "A(E)liens"

• "Yoroshiku★Girl," (also known as "4649 Girl," pronounced as "Yoroshiku★Shōjo," a pun on the words "Nice to Meet You★Girl" with the literal meaning of the kanji being "Evening Dew Heads to Its Death★Girl." The numbers 4649 can be read in Japanese as "Yoroshiku.")

• "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" ("Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni," literally, Nocturne: On This Grotesque Night, romanized in a previous video as "Nocturn: En Cette Nuit Grotesque.")

The film's cast members and characters include :

Atsushi Nishigori ( The IDOLM@STER , DARLING in the FRANXX ) directed the film, and also wrote the screenplay and designed the characters.

The band METALVERSE performs the opening theme song "Shoot Shoot Shoot." Haoto performs the ending theme song with lyrics by momosu momosu.

The film comes from JOEN , the company jointly established by Sony media subsidiary Aniplex , its CloverWorks animation studio, Production I.G sister company Wit Studio , and publisher Shueisha . CloverWorks producer Yūichi Fukushima and Wit Studio producer Tetsuya Nakatake are the representative directors of JOEN .

The film opened in Japan on November 6 at #8 in the box office. The film earned 47,185,800 yen (about US$297,000) in its first three days.. The film's "Yoroshiku★Girl" segment streamed early for a limited time on Netflix in Japan from October 23 to November 5.

The film had its world premiere at this year's Fantasia International Film Festival , which took place in Montreal from July 16-August 2. The Japan Society host the U.S. premiere of the film in collaboration with CloverWorks and Aniplex of America in New York City on October 8. Director Nishigori gave a pre-screening introduction in-person at the event.

title: Omoi Announces Digital Release of Shō Asahina's Tsuyo-Girl Manga in January
content:
Digital manga publisher Omoi announced on Thursday the exclusive digital release of Shō Asahina 's Tsuyo-Girl manga on its website and app in January. Omoi will release the manga with the English title Tsuyo-Girl: Taking Charge .

Omoi describes the manga's story:

Straight black hair with a blonde streak, chunky earrings, and striking red lipstick — Yuki starts college with a strong sense of style that makes heads turn. But a week passes, and she hasn't made a single friend. All of her classmates are too intimidated to even approach her! Just when she begins to lose hope, Yuki discovers that her favorite fashion influencer attends her school and reconnects with an old classmate who still has feelings for her. Could these chance encounters be the beginning of the friendships and connections Yuki has been searching for? From Shō Asahina , creator of It's Not Easy Being Cute , and originally published in the magazine Comic Elmo ( The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting , Natsume & Natsume ), Tsuyo-Girl: Taking Charge is a bold and fashion-forward romantic comedy about self-expression and confidence, with an earnest main character you just can't help but root for.

Asahina launched the manga on Micro Magazine 's Comic Elmo manga website in April 2021. Micro Magazine published the manga's first compiled book volume in October 2021, and the manga ended with its fifth volume in December 2022.

Asahina's It's Not Easy Being Cute ( "Kawaii" wa, Tokidoki Kurushii. ) manga launched on X (formerly Twitter ) in September 2024. It began serialization on Gangan pixiv in September 2025. The manga recently ended with its third volume on October 22. Both Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service and Comikey publish the manga in English digitally.

title: This World is Worth Fighting For Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content:
Hatsumi Kodama 's This World is Worth Fighting For ( Kono Yo wa Tatakau Kachi ga Aru ) manga is getting a live-action series on Fuji TV in January 2027.

Hiyori Sakurada stars as Ito Kiri.

Kaede Kamiya is directing the series. Yasuko Kuramitsu is writing the screenplay.

Ito Kiri has had enough. She's 25, is in her third year at a company she hates where she's also getting sexually harassed, and dating a shitty guy. She exists solely on energy drinks and one thought: “I want to be useful to others.” But she's beginning to reach her limit and feeling hopeless about her future. That is, until she receives a mysterious letter one day. No return address, no name, just a message she needed: Permission to live freely and on her terms. From that moment, something changes in her and she decides she's doing whatever it takes to live a life worth living. And she's not holding back or pulling any punches.

Kodama debuted the manga in Shogakukan 's Big Comic Spirits magazine in April 2023, and ended it in October 2025. The fifth and final compiled book volume shipped in Japan on January 30.

title: hololive Shop Reports Customer Information Leak
content:
OPENLOGI had announced that its systems were subject to unauthorized access between November 8-9. The hololive shop outsourced shipping operations to OPENLOGI until June 2025, but it has since stopped using its services. However, some of the shipping data taken externally were from when hololive shop used OPENLOGI's services.

The information leaked includes names, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, order numbers, purchase amounts, and tracking numbers for about 300 shipping records for orders placed on hololive shop between September 1, 2022-November 25, 2024. Credit card information is not included in the leak.

The hololive shop has begun contacting individual customers via email on Tuesday. The company reported this incident to the Personal Information Protection Commission of Japan. It also requested OPENLOGI to provide a report of the incident and handle remaining customer information belonging to hololive shop appropriately.

The first generation of hololive performers debuted in 2018. There are over 80 virtual YouTubers who currently belong to hololive. The talents perform using intricate 2D and 3D avatars provided by the company. COVER Corporation launched hololive Indonesia — a spinoff group aimed toward the Indonesian audience — in April 2020, followed by hololive English in September 2020. The all-male holostars spinoff group debuted its first generation talent in June 2019. According to hololive production 's English website , it has over 90 million subscribers across all its channels.

In related news, online retailer CDJapan reported on Wednesday that customers' personal information was exposed to third parties as a result of unauthorized access.
